faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DHS Koderma Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the DHS Koderma Recruitment 2026 is 02-09-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in DHS Koderma Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 24 vacancies for Medical Specialists and ICU Staff posts in the District Health Society Koderma Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply for this recruitment through email.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts in this recruitment is 67 years.

faq.question: Q5. What are the eligibility criteria for the ICU Resident/Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: For the ICU Resident/Medical Officer post, candidates must possess an MBBS degree along with a one-year diploma or equivalent certificate course in Critical Care Medicine.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Physician/Medicine Specialist post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Physician/Medicine Specialist post is Rs. 400/- per OPD patient plus a share from the PMJAY package.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for DHS Koderma Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Medical Specialists and ICU Staff posts will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the walk-in date for the interview?
faq.answer: The interview for the DHS Koderma Recruitment 2026 is scheduled for 03-09-2026.
